# 2 bedroom flat for sale

> Graham & Co are delighted to present to market this sharp and elegant two bedroom flat, located in a beautifully converted period building. Sold with no onward chain. Converted from a stunning period building, this immaculate two-bedroom, two-bathroom first floor apartment offers refined living in the heart of the city.
